methods.label: Combine the problem counts
methods.explanation:
Every problem contributes equally to the overall percentage, so first count the correct answers on each test. Those counts are
\[
0.80\cdot25=20,\qquad
0.90\cdot40=36,\qquad
0.70\cdot10=7.
\]
Ryan therefore answered \(20+36+7=63\) problems correctly out of \(25+40+10=75\) problems. His overall percentage is
\[
\frac{63}{75}=0.84=84\%.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{84\%}\), choice D.
methods.levelReason: Uses percentages of whole-number counts and a part-to-total fraction.
